prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 35 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1215; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a sideswipe collision that occurred while the patient was changing lanes, reporting neck and low back pain with associated muscle stiffness. The mechanism of the collision is consistent with the reported soft tissue injuries. Initial examination showed reduced cervical and lumbar range of motion with paraspinal muscle tenderness, while neurological screening and imaging-related assessments were within normal limits. No prior complaints or treatment involving the cervical or lumbar regions are documented in the available history. Care followed a conventional course of manual therapy, therapeutic exercise, and home stretching instruction across 35 visits. Frequency of visits decreased steadily as symptoms resolved and mobility improved, and discharge was planned once the patient reached functional goals. Billing records reflect a single charge for each service rendered, with no duplicated entries. Prognosis is good with continued self-directed exercise.
